decisions.title: Adopt Blueprint and build icon catalogue
decisions.quote: First I want to convert this into a Utkal Blueprint project and a build icon list for our icon that we can use
decisions.scope: Local Blueprint conversion and reusable icon list. Design acceptance and publication remain separate.

decisions.title: Literary benchmark and theme-grounded icon design
decisions.quote: Study the most popular poetry and literary sites and see if we can learn from them.
decisions.scope: Research reference sites and prepare Odisha-linked, earthy, poetic icon candidates per the same user message.

decisions.title: Option A single-colour icon treatment
decisions.scope: Single-colour Quiet ink treatment selected. Specific motif placement remains under review; earth accents are not the selected direction.
decisions.quote: I like the icon with the single-color option A

decisions.title: Show the editors with their defined roles
decisions.quote: Add the editors with their defined roles to the website.
decisions.scope: Make the publication editors and their sourced titles visible in the local site; link their profiles. No invented duties, appointments or reporting structure.

decisions.title: Complete Blueprint persona setup
decisions.quote: Let's go ahead and implement UB?
decisions.scope: Four pinned Blueprint personas adapted to KBL and assigned for on-demand work in the current chat; current permissions only.

decisions.title: Move all non-site work into the KB
decisions.quote: All the things that we have done that are not part of the site should move to KB
decisions.scope: Supporting files, historical assets and local review material become KB-owned; preserve working site and portable handoff.

decisions.title: Self-contained replacement website and Git/analytics preparation
decisions.quote: This is a new redesign and a complete, self-sufficient site - we should not link anything to the old site. This will replace the old site.
decisions.scope: Remove reader-facing legacy dependencies; prepare local Git and analytics under the same user request. Full content import remains required; no deployment is implied.

decisions.title: Private feedback, social sharing and Utkal-aligned Firebase approach
decisions.quote: Social sharing and private feedback; no public comments for launch (recommended)
decisions.scope: Apply selected engagement model. Review Utkal Project and follow its static-public/private-Firebase approach; no GA4 ID exists yet.

decisions.title: GitHub project storage and GitHub Pages hosting
decisions.quote: We will store everything in GitHub, and the website will be a git site
decisions.scope: Follow Utkal Project stack; GitHub owns source, KB and historical assets, Pages serves the static build, Firebase holds private runtime feedback.

decisions.title: Create private repository and free Firebase project
decisions.quote: Approve repository creation and Firebase terms
decisions.scope: Private ahimanikya/kabita-live repository and Firebase terms acceptance; Mumbai Firestore and IST Analytics approved separately. No paid plan, repository publicity or site publication authorized.
